title: Treat internal users as customers
summary: Staff who use internal tools deserve the same care as customers. Research their work and design for it.

beginner: Identify the staff groups who will use the tool.
Watch them at work and note their pain points.
Find out what tools they use alongside it.
Measure time saved and errors reduced.
intermediate: Test with real staff and data.
experienced: Measure the business value of internal tools.
Build a feedback loop with staff.
Hold internal tools to public-facing standards.

toolExamples.miro: Map a day in the life of each staff group.
toolExamples.sharepoint-word: Gather feedback through existing staff channels.
